# cf-lite

> Vite plugin + CLI for Cloudflare Workers apps: file routes, Hono API, opt-in modules (auth, storage, jobs, ISR, RSC, preview). Open source (MIT), version 0.x.

Generated by `bun run llms:gen` from `docs/`; do not edit. Agent rules: [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/cf-lite/cf-lite/blob/main/AGENTS.md).

- [Conventions: how a file layout becomes generated code](https://github.com/cf-lite/cf-lite/blob/main/docs/conventions.md): cf-lite has no runtime. Everything a convention does happens at build time: generate() (called by the Vite plugin on start and on every route-file change)...
